lessons.text: A failing check is not automatically a product defect. Distinguish malformed test, wrong fixture, missing tool/service and inconsistent candidate copy from failure of an explicit user-facing requirement. Never weaken production safeguards or change shipped validation merely to satisfy a defective check. Complete approved phase implementation before authorized behavior-driven real integration; inspect aggregate commands for prohibited isolated tests.

lessons.text: Preserve exact source and failure evidence before validation repairs: aggregate hashes cannot reconstruct uncommitted before/after files, and discarded stderr prevents diagnosis. Report source completion, actual acceptance, publication and installed operation separately. Stop when the user says stop testing; do not rename or delegate it. Do not spend an unbounded release cycle engineering certification frameworks or promise a deadline that excludes human merges and missing prerequisites.
